source.title: Antandra - Desert Fury
source.name: Antandra
source.description: A brave Tank to provide an ally sustained protection in a battle.

skills.name: Shield Assault

description.raw: Antandra sets her shield up and taunts enemies within 2 tiles for 1s, reducing her damage taken by 60%and becoming Unaffected for 5s. Afterward, she raises the shield to stun adjacent enemies for 2s and swings the spear, dealing 400% (ATK-based) damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them down, recovering 20% (HP-based) HР + 5% (SP-based) HP. Each enemy hit recovers her an extra 8% (HP-based) + 2% (SP-based).
active: Antandra sets her shield up and taunts enemies within 2 tiles for 1s, reducing her damage taken by 60%and becoming Unaffected for 5s.

Afterward, she raises the shield to stun adjacent enemies for 2s and swings the spear, dealing 400% (ATK-based) damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them down, recovering 20% (HP-based) HР + 5% (SP-based) HP.
Each enemy hit recovers her an extra 8% (HP-based) + 2% (SP-based).

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases damage to 420% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases damage to 440% (ATK-based)
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 450% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases damage to 460% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Reduces incoming damage, stuns surrounding enemies with her shield after a while, and strikes down the enemies with her spear to deal damage and heal herself.

skills.name: Shield Formation

description.raw: Antandra selects the frontmost ally (except herself) as the guarded ally when a battle starts. Antandra grants herself and the guarded ally shields that block damage equal to 15% + 5% (SP-based) of the ally's max HP for 5s, and the shield value is up to 500% (ATK-based) of her ATK. Antandra reselects another front-most all (except herself) as the guarded ally if the previous one is defeated.
active: Antandra selects the frontmost ally (except herself) as the guarded ally when a battle starts.
Antandra grants herself and the guarded ally shields that block damage equal to 15% + 5% (SP-based) of the ally's max HP for 5s, and the shield value is up to 500% (ATK-based) of her ATK.
Antandra reselects another front-most all (except herself) as the guarded ally if the previous one is defeated.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Reduces the skill cooldown by 3s whenever the guarded ally loses 10% (HP-based) max HP.
Unlocks at level 131: Increases the shield value to 20% + 5% (SP-based) of the guarded ally's max HP.
Unlocks at level 191: Increases the shield value to 25% + 5% (SP-based) of the guarded ally's max HP.

skills.description_lite: Selects an ally to guard, granting them and herself shields.

skills.name: Spear Barrage

description.raw: Antandra attacks the frontal area within 1-tile arc 3 times and reduces the targets' ATK by 20% for 6s + 1 (SP-based)s, with the first 2 hits dealing 100% (ATK-based) damage and the third hit dealing 120% (ATK-based) damage.
